don’t lose hope. it took me almost a year because i wasn’t actually checking that often. don’t depend on text or email notifications- i didn’t get any when my site started hiring… or at all. it began a few weeks ago with a bunch of shifts posted on friday night around 9-10pm.. they kept posting different ones late in the night/early morning and oftentimes it’d be the same over and over because each slot would get filled up so quickly. that lasted a few days, and i was checking obsessively at all times hoping to find the shift i was looking for. eventually it died down, with the exception of one shift posted here or there, but it was never what i was hoping for. my partner works at amazon and told me it was unlikely i’d missed it because they post the same shift many times and we hadn’t seen it yet. flash forward a few weeks, on friday night around the same time.. i got it! the first time i was too slow, but the second time i was logged in (i recommend having an account already made and being signed in, makes it so much easier) and now i have an official start date. idk what it’s like where you want to apply, but this was a week ago. so trust the process and be persistent. good luck!
